2025/26.title: The Rules That Unbind Us All
2025/26.description: We discuss the controversial rules in football and debate what changes we'd love to see.

2025/26.title: The Role of Science & Technology in Football
2025/26.description: AI may get the attention, but science and technology have been shaping football for years. We discuss whether data and new tech are being used well in the game—and what we make of it.

2025/26.title: Grading The A League
2025/26.description: After visiting HBF Park in April, we play A-League CEO and discuss how we'd reshape Australia's flagship competition into something stronger than it is today.

2025/26.title: The Big Whinge
2025/26.description: With the World Cup underway, we have our biggest whinge yet on the redesigned tournament format, hydration breaks that feel like ad breaks, and fixture congestion.

2024/25.title: Club Ownership Structures
2024/25.description: We explore the different ownership structures in football clubs and if one is better than the other.

2024/25.title: The Christmas Episode
2024/25.description: We discuss home ground advantage and how crowd atmosphere can impact players - both positively and negatively.

2024/25.title: Best Elevens
2024/25.description: We go through UEFA's Team of the Tournament from the last decade, debate our favourites, and create our own predicted 2024/25 Team of the Year.

2023/24.title: Football in Australia
2023/24.description: We explore why football struggles to gain mainstream popularity in Australia despite the nation's sporting culture.

2023/24.title: All About The Money
2023/24.description: We discuss the new Champions League and World Cup formats - are they really about improving the competitions, or just UEFA and FIFA's way of squeezing more money out of more games?

2023/24.title: The Tier List
2023/24.description: We discuss the lack of a proper winter break and how the short Christmas pause doesn't give teams enough time to reset for the second half of the season. Plus, we rank players from Barcelona, Man City, and PSG in our tier lists.

2023/24.title: Individual Titles
2023/24.description: We discuss the reforms needed for the Ballon d'Or and debate how the winner should actually be chosen.

2023/24.title: Financial Fair Play
2023/24.description: We discuss Financial Fair Play - what it means on paper versus how it's being applied inconsistently across clubs, even within the same competitions.

2023/24.title: Battle of the International Tournaments
2023/24.description: We compare the Euros and Copa America, debating the different challenges teams face in each tournament.
